window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; only two verifiable new stories surfaced.

stories.headline: South African police seize about 250 kg of cocaine in five bags at Johannesburg's OR Tambo airport
stories.summary: Police announced on 25 October that 216 blocks of cocaine were found spread across five bags, with an estimated value above R200 million (about US$12 million).

stories.headline: Lithuanian police dismantle a large drug lab holding over 800 kg of meth and amphetamine after a Polish tip-off
stories.summary: Police found more than 500 kg of methamphetamine and about 300 kg of amphetamine at the lab, reported on 25 October.
